steps.title: Getting started
steps.text: Talk to Seren on the 1st floor (2nd floor[US]) of Burthorpe Castle.

steps.title: Thok's story
steps.text: Talk to Mr. Mordaut at the Anachronia base camp.
Talk to Thok to the north-west.
Smash the less enormous but still a lizard dinos.

actions.displayName: Less enormous but still a lizard

steps.text: Walk down the path for more dialogue.
Continue down the path then listen to Thok.
Restore the dragonkin device at the archaeologist's workbench.
Restore the dragonkin tablet at an archaeologist's workbench.

steps.title: Nodon hibernatorium shared memory
steps.text:
Talk to Hannibus at the Anachronia Dinosaur Farm.
  • Teleport with the mystical tree on the 1st floor (2nd floor[US]) of the Ardougne Manor Farm.
Enter the Nodon Hibernatorium on the north-eastern coast of Anachronia.
Wait for the Nodon caretaker to enter the pylon passcode. Remember/screenshot the passcode for the a following step.
steps.warning: Remember/screenshot the passcode for the a following step.

steps.text: Input the passcode on the pylon matching what you saw in the dream.
Follow the nodon caretaker for the passphrase. Remember/screenshot the passphrase for the a following step.
steps.warning: Remember/screenshot the passphrase for the a following step.

steps.text:
Return to Hannibus.
  • Alternatively, you can lobby and log back in.
Attack Kerapac or let your party attack him until he leaves.
Talk to Primrose in the house by the Needle.

actions.text: Does the Needle have any weaknesses?
What was it like being her?

steps.title: Meeting Jas
steps.text: Talk to Seren outside of the Heart in the Kharidian Desert.

steps.title: Dinosaur invasion
steps.text: Talk to Charos in the Anachronia base camp.
Talk to Thok. You can't be wielding anything in your hands.

Talk to Charos.
  • If you exit the dialogue too early you need to leave and talk to Thok again.
Change Charos' attack type to closest (1).
Move Hannibus to the marked tile.
Move Hannibus back to his original tile.

Click the start button.
  • Your character will automatically attack the dinosaurs.
  • If you struggle, move around to get early hits on the bigger dinosaurs.

Talk to Charos again to the north.
  • If Charos doesn't give you The Measure, check your bank.

Place The Measure on the marked tile.
  • Lobby if Charos isn't near the marked tile for the next few steps.
Place The Measure on the marked tile again.
Place The Measure on the marked tile yet again.
Place The Measure on the marked tile once again.
Talk to Charos north of the base camp once you're ready for combat.
Enter the code 2-1-4 into the pylon.

steps.title: Black stone dragon
steps.text: Kill the black stone dragon to the north.

Escape the lab.
  • When you hit a dead end, turn around or interact with a nearby character.
  • If you fail to escape, re-enter Kerapac's lab to try again.
